text: Did the student fail the course because of poor attendance?
Was the student's course grade affected by something other than their scores on tests and exams?
Did the student fail the course because of academic dishonesty, such as cheating or plagiarism?
Did the student fail because of missing or incomplete coursework other than tests and exams (such as homework, assignments, or projects)?
Did the student fail because they violated a course rule or policy unrelated to the quality of their academic work?
Did the student fail because they did not take or complete a required final exam or final assessment?
Did the course include a required practical or physical component (such as a lab, performance, or skills demonstration) that was graded separately from written tests and exams?
Was the failure due to an administrative or bureaucratic reason rather than the student's academic performance?
